newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready moves Peterson to COO post.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready moves Peterson to COO post.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc said Friday it has moved Ralph E. Peterson to the new position of executive vice president and chief operating officer from his current post as chief financial officer.

A search for a new chief financial officer is underway, Labor Ready said in a statement. The company, headquartered in Tacoma, provides temporary workers to the light industrial, construction and small businesses.
Peterson joined Labor Ready in January after serving for five years as executive vice president and chief financial officer of Rax Restaurants Inc, based in Ohio.
